text:
Olivia: quick heads-up — APAC SI onboarding credits for the marketplace launch are looking oversubscribed. Finance flagged ~30% overcommit if all partners spin up at once. Can we triage and propose a contingency? :thinking:
Samir: ack — can you paste the list of SIs that are tagged high-priority? I can re-run the allocation model today.
Jess P: putting it here: https://go.redwood/partner-onboard-apac (see sheet tab ‘SI-priorities’). Top 6 are: SakuraTech, KinovaSys, BlueTide SI, Haneul Labs, Prism Integrations, CloudWeave.
Alina M: we also have co-marketing MDF reserved for 4 of those. If we need to bump credits, that’s the pool to flex. But legal needs notice for modifications.
Olivia: thanks. Two asks: (1) Samir — run two scenarios: a) strict priority (top 3 only get full credits), b) pro-rata with 20% contingency holdback. (2) Jess/Alina — confirm which MDF line items are movable without legal signoff.
Samir: will run both scenarios. quick note on inputs — need expected activation date per SI and estimated VM/GPU usage numbers. Can you drop those in the sheet?
Jess P: added a new column for "est. peak GPU weeks". filled conservative numbers for top 6.
Samir: running model now. rough preview:
```
scenarioA_total_committed = $420k
scenarioB_total_committed = $360k
contingency_holdback = $72k (20%)
```
Samir: scenario A means we exceed MDF by ~$50k after reallocations; scenario B keeps us under but reduces per-SI allotment by ~15%.
Alina M: do we have runway to pull from global partner co-op budget? That could cover the delta without changing partner expectations.
Olivia: short-term yes but that reduces runway for EMEA pilots. Preference is scenario B + fast follow-up allocation for top 2 if activation metrics hit thresholds.
Jess P: agree. Also suggest adding a soft clause in onboarding comms: "credits subject to availability and activation milestones" — reduces downstream backlash. Legal can bless a short line.
marketplace-bot: reminder — marketplace launch checklist step 7 incomplete: "Confirm MDF allocations". Assigned to @Olivia.
Alina M: next steps: I’ll draft a one-paragraph amendment to the MDF memo for legal review (ETA 24h). Samir please post the two scenario outputs in the thread when done.
Samir: posting results in 45m, then we can lock a comms cadence to partners.
Olivia: perfect. If we need to run a fast QBR-style readout with GTM + Sales Ops, schedule 30m tomorrow 7:30am PT. Anyone opposed?
Jess P: fine for me.
Alina M: works.
Samir: works.
Olivia: thanks team. I’ll own partner comms copy after we decide. :thumbsup:
